device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU
cached_norm_reference: The same synthetic gradient norm was computed once before timing to model the value published by the optimizer; this is not a DeepSpeed parity test.
measurement: Local single-GPU microbenchmark of the redundant Trainer-side norm scan. The cached path reads the norm already computed inside DeepSpeed's optimizer step; that optimizer work, distributed safe_get_full_grad all-gathers, model training, and end-to-end B200 time are excluded. Only optimizer-boundary norms are reported.
